units.source_text: 他脑海里描绘出一幅纸的火星降临父亲家引起火灾的情景。

en.t: In his mind he pictured a scene in which sparks from the paper fell onto his father's house and started a fire.

units.source_text: 他想象着：如果父亲还健在，看到火苗从自己的工厂烧到自己的家，不知会多么惊慌。

en.t: He imagined how, if his father were still alive, he would be terribly alarmed to see the flames spread from his own factory to his own home.
